 GTA 6 launch build references multiplayer features, but Rockstar has yet to announce GTA Online
 GTA 6's launch build reportedly contains multiplayer activity entries ahead of its November 19 release.
 Today, 08:43 GMT • WhyCry • 2 min read Set as Preferred Source Follow on Google © RockStar Games PlayStation backend data includes multiplayer activity options ahead of the November 19 release. 
 With Grand Theft Auto VI now just ten days away from release, more information is appearing in PlayStation’s backend database. PlayStation Game Size, an account known for tracking game updates and download sizes, has found references to multiplayer functionality associated with GTA 6. The discovery comes just before pre-loading begins on November 10.
 The account shared three entries found in the PlayStation backend: joinSession , launchActivity , and launchMultiplayerActivity . These are PlayStation activity intent types that can allow players to join sessions or launch specific game activities directly from the console interface. Their presence suggests that GTA 6 has at least some integration prepared for multiplayer features.
 Grand Theft Auto VI supports :
 intentType": "joinSession"
intentType": "launchActivity"
intentType": "launchMultiplayerActivity"
 — PlayStation Game Size (@PlaystationSize) November 9, 2026 
 GTA Online launch date remains unknown
 However, these entries do not confirm that multiplayer will be available at launch. Rockstar currently describes GTA 6 as a single-player experience and has not announced a release date for its online component. 
 1 / 5 ‹ › ⛶ © RockStar Games For comparison, the original GTA Online launched on October 1, 2013, two weeks after GTA 5. Red Dead Online followed roughly one month after Red Dead Redemption 2, initially launching in beta. Whether Rockstar plans a similar schedule for GTA 6 remains unknown. Previous reports have suggested that multiplayer could arrive in 2027.
 The discovery comes alongside other technical details shared by PlayStation Game Size. The current PS5 build reportedly carries version number 01.001.004, while the New Zealand and Australian package is listed at approximately 223 GB. Rockstar has officially confirmed that GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Pre-loading starts tomorrow, November 10, giving players their first opportunity to download the game ahead of release.
